_purpose: §65 공식 v3 정상 데이터 9세션 수집 사전등록 - docs/design/phase8-blue-green-preflight-incident.md §65와 동일 내용, 기계 판독용. 측정 전 커밋·푸시, 이후 수정하지 않는다.
scope: data collection and quality audit only - no model training, no threshold determination

burst.pattern: 0.025 RPS base (60s) x5 alternating with 0.10 RPS pulse (20s) x4

inter_session_procedure: clean preflight (next session's own fail-closed start check covers this)

idle_regime_from_section_58.source: windows.ACTIVE_PLUS_PREVIEW_SESSIONS (6 sessions, re-verified strict completeness: 0 invalid windows across all 6, 32 total valid rows)
idle_regime_from_section_58.regime_label: probe_baseline (kept as-is, not renamed to low_load/sustained_load/burst)
idle_regime_from_section_58.role_assignment_rule: session_id alphabetical order, round-robin train/calibration/holdout, fixed before checking pass/fail - not chosen after seeing results

active_only_from_section_58.status: excluded from train/calibration/holdout - topology differs from detector's real operating condition
active_only_from_section_58.retained_as: out-of-domain topology diagnostic reference only, not deleted

valid_session_conditions: t_slo == null (covers both 30s-sustained latency violation and immediate availability violation)
no missing/NaN/stale on any of the 8 feature source metrics (zero invalid windows)
feature window timestamps fall within session boundaries (window_boundary_ok)
cfs_throttle_policy: recorded as an observed characteristic of the current 3-core environment, not a session-exclusion criterion

failure_and_rerun_rules.technical_harness_error: preserve raw data, record invalid_session with exact reason, fix code + pass offline tests, rerun from scratch under a NEW session_id
failure_and_rerun_rules.sustained_slo_violation_or_restart_or_oo: treat as a reproducibility failure of the normal profile - stop remaining sessions immediately, do not adjust intensity or run an ad hoc substitute session
failure_and_rerun_rules.missing_metric: never zero-substitute - mark session invalid, investigate cause, report
failure_and_rerun_rules.no_cherry_picking: each regime must obtain exactly 3 valid sessions (one per split role) - never settle for 2 of 3 because a result looks unfavorable for the model

preserved_per_session: raw Prometheus response or reproducible query manifest (features.py.METRICS as-is)
queue/cache non-zero sample and window counts
post_collection_audit_only: session and valid-row counts per regime
train/calibration/holdout candidate session IDs per block
final candidate matrix size including idle sessions
whether the targeted session-level split is achievable
holdout_stage_gate: at this stage: schema, row count, missing-data, and session-validity checks only - actual anomaly score and FPR computation happens exactly once, after model and threshold are frozen (out of this task's scope)
queue_policy: if constant across training candidates, mark as zero-variance removal candidate - do not fabricate variance
cache_policy: real variance was observed (§64.3) - preserve raw data, do not auto-exclude
scope_limits: no holdout anomaly score or FPR computation

tooling.script: anomaly-detection/v3/qualify_normal_profile.py (extended with --official --split-role, reuses the exact §63 session logic)
